name: HTK
formula: shape = mean_symm + t * axis + sum_i z_i * sigma[i] * components[i]  (right half, 193 CVs)
axis: axis = mean_asym - mean_symm: t = 0 is the symmetric mean, t = 1 the asymmetric (ergo) mean
gene: full 386-CV gene (both halves) added to the mirrored shape: gene_mean + sum_i w_i * gene_sigma[i] * gene_components[i] (first eight patches; the other eight are mirror-antisymmetric), or genes/<name>.npy (NP-01, NP-01S, U2: one mouse each)
error_definition: per-mouse RMS of the CV Euclidean distance (mm) when that mouse is left out of the fit; median and max over mice
